title: Release Gate Findings Lifecycle Policy v1
description: Governed lifecycle policy for release gate findings. Each entry classifies a finding by exact finding_id + check_id match and specifies lifecycle state, severity override, release-blocking override, owner, rationale, and optional expiration.

policy_id.description: Stable identifier for this policy instance (e.g., 'release_gate_findings_lifecycle_v0').

description.description: Human-readable description of this policy instance.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this policy was last updated.

finding_id.description: Exact finding_id to match. Wildcards not supported in v1.

check_id.description: Exact check_id to match. Combined with finding_id for deterministic lookup.

severity_override.description: Optional effective severity override. When set, replaces the original severity for gate status derivation.

release_blocking_override.description: Optional override for release-blocking behavior. When false, a blocker/high finding will not cause gate failure regardless of lifecycle_state.

reason.description: Justification for this lifecycle classification. Required for auditability.

owner.description: Person or team accountable for this classification.

expires.description: Optional expiration date in YYYY-MM-DD format. After this date the entry is expired and no longer suppresses or downgrades findings.

evidence_refs.description: Optional references to evidence supporting this classification (e.g., issue URLs, commit SHAs, audit reports).
